options.name: progression_balancing
options.description:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: accessibility
options.description:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: goal_condition
options.description:
Sets the condition for clearing your game.
Steel on Steel and Zero Seconds to Midnight: Clear the chosen level
Gear Hunt: Receive a configurable number of Golden Gears

options.name: gear_hunt_requirement
options.description:
Sets the required number of Golden Gears for the Gear Hunt goal condition.
Does nothing if the goal condition is not set to Gear Hunt.

options.name: world_unlock_mode
options.description:
Changes how the overall worlds are unlocked.
Automatic unlocks worlds whenever a stage in that world is unlocked.
Item adds the worlds as items to the pool that need to be obtained before those worlds are accessible.

options.name: intermission_world_unlocks
options.description:
Controls where the checks for the worlds of Civilization and Chaos are.
If enabled, the checks will be from completing the intermission (The Space Between Worlds).
If disabled, the checks will be after completing the boss levels of Nature and Space. 
Does nothing if World Unlock Mode is set to automatic.

options.name: steel_on_steel_shackle_requirement
options.description: The number of Laplus' Shackles required to access Steel on Steel

options.name: zero_seconds_to_midnight_shackle_requirement
options.display_name: Zero Seconds to Midnight Shackle Requirement
options.description: The number of Laplus' Shackles required to access Zero Seconds to Midnight

options.name: early_chrono_gear
options.description:
Controls whether the Chrono Gear is usable in levels before you would normally obtain it.
If disabled, the Chrono Gear is only usable in the levels it is normally usable in (A Way Home and later).
If enabled, it is usable in all levels once acquired.
